meaningful_new_evidence_if_any: a 60-day grace-state, post-window vehicle/credential, prior-state-persistence, or meaningful-title flag changes
weak_minor_update_definition: At least one linked T1 record exists, but none of the meaningful-evidence conditions is true.
effectively_no_meaningful_update_definit: No linked T1 record, no newly effective T0 record, and no relevant grace-window or persistence-state change. Passive time/decay changes may still exist.
